title: Arrow
description: A curved arrow from A to B that draws itself on (the stroke is revealed, then the head pops), with an optional label at its tail on a plate. A and B are in the picture's pixels, so a point read from a recording works unchanged. Place it with the same transform as the footage it annotates; pairs with kit-callout and kit-spotlight. Takes a theme.

from.description: The tail, in the picture's pixels

to.description: The head points here, in the picture's pixels

space.description: Size of the picture the points refer to (a recording's pixels)

fit.description: How the picture sits in the item box (as the footage item's fit)

label.description: A short text at the tail (empty: none)

curve.description: How far the arrow bends, as a share of its length; the sign picks the side (0 = straight)

width.description: Line width in % of the frame's short side

head.description: Head size, 1 = as drawn by default

size.description: Label size in % of the frame's short side

color.description: Arrow colour, a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

draw.description: Seconds the stroke takes to draw on

author: claude-opus-5-5
